notes.title: The Alchemical Update #08
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

If you caught our "Director Let's Play & Announcement" video in the previous Alchemical Update, you know that we've been busy brewing up new content for Little Noah: Scion of Paradise. Today, we're happy to announce that our fourth major update is out! (For those who missed the video, check it out here.)

Now, let's talk about what's included in Major Update #4!
------

New VERY HARD Difficulty
This mode will be available from System > Options in the menu after clearing the game, along with VERY HARD+ and VERY HARD++ upon additional completions.

Zip Around the Ruins as Zipper
Upon clearing the game, the option to play as Zipper will be unlocked in the Avatars menu. When playing as Zipper, you'll have less HP and won't be able to use potions. On the other hand (or is it paw?), you'll have increased movement speed and be able to perform double jumps, as well as a modified dash, Aether Thrust, and Avatar Burst.

Toggle Airship Facilities On and Off
You can now restrict airship facilities and the appearance of Lilliputs and accessories to tweak gameplay difficulty. This feature is accessible from the airship once airship repairs reach 30% through the Customize Game menu. When an airship facility is restricted, its effects won't apply to Noah; restricting the appearance of Lilliputs and Accessories will cause them to not appear during expeditions. Airship repair progress won’t be affected by restrictions, so feel free to experiment and find what works best for you!

------

We hope you enjoy exploring the ruins as Zipper! Keep an eye out for our next update!

Until we meet again!

Little Noah Development Team

notes.title: The Alchemical Update #06 A New Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We hope you’ve been enjoying Little Noah. This update is a fun one!

The first major change you might notice is that we’ve added a bunch of voice lines for Noah! She’ll have a lot more to say during various boss battles, discovering Lilliputs, and many more scenes. We hope that you’ll enjoy hearing what she has to say throughout her adventures. 😊

We’ve updated one more thing as well regarding the game’s interface. Many players have informed us that upon encountering a new accessory or Lilliput, it was difficult to tell whether they’d already acquired it previously. For this reason, we’ve added an indicator in the form of a “NEW” icon to any newly discovered accessories or Lilliputs. We hope to continue adding little updates like this one to make your treks through the ruins a little smoother, whether you’re a seasoned player or diving in for the first time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585670/4b47b74fa4f38eaa56f76b3e036f2312779be232.png

That’s all from us this time. See you in the next Alchemical Update!

The Little Noah Development Team

notes.title: The Alchemical Update #05 The second major update & new DLC are now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.
I hope you are enjoying Little Noah: Scion of Paradise! Today we have some exciting news!

Following the first major update and the first DLC, which were both very popular, the second major update and DLC are now available for download!

In the first major update, we answered everyone's passion for challenging ruins at a higher level of difficulty with the "HELL Mode".
In this second major update, we have prepared a new mode, "Witch's Trials," in which you can challenge a series of battles against tough bosses in order to encourage research-oriented alchemists to embark on a journey of further adventure and exploration!

Also, the second DLC includes a collaboration avatar with "Uma Musume: Pretty Derby", a new lilliput, and new accessories! Please take a look at this page for more details.

We will continue to bring updates and new announcements to everyone here.
Also, your comments and feedback are a great encouragement to our development team! Please let us know what you think of the new mode so that we can make the game better with future updates.

See you in the next Alchemical Update!

The Little Noah Development Team

notes.title: The Alchemical Update #04 How do we like our eggs? AMA Reflections.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Little Noah Development Team here.

We just recently finished our very first Reddit AMA on r/games and received many warm words and interesting questions!

Thank you very much to everyone who participated!! Our team had a ton of fun!
We received lots of honest and great opinions about Little Noah. We got to talk about things like our favorite Lilliputs, roguelite games, and how we like to alchemize our scrambled eggs!

Even if you couldn’t participate, you can still check out the thread below:
https://www.reddit.com/r/Games/comments/wjpdbl/were_japanese_game_devs_and_codirectors_of_little/

We asked our directors to share some final words and comments here.
------------------
- Hiroki Matsuura, Director
Thank you all for all your questions.
I was very happy to read everyone’s comments, and it really made me feel inspired for future updates and new titles.
Among lots of serious questions, one redditor decided to ask us how we like our scrambled eggs, which was a fun side conversation.
It was a pretty timely question for me personally!
I look forward to being able to interact with all of you again!

- Kengo Shibata, Co-Director
I’d say that being able to talk about our favorite Lilliputs was the most interesting for me.
Also chatting about which games inspired us was fun.
We got many more questions than I expected, which was a pleasant surprise.
Also, just to hear everyone who has played Little Noah say, “I had fun” was very rewarding.
Thank you very much!
------------------

See you in the next Alchemical Update!

The Little Noah Development Team

notes.title: Steam Ver.1.01b Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Greetings from the Little Noah Development Team.

First, we’d like to thank all of you for your comments and reactions to our news posts!
We are happy to see that everyone is enjoying the game and have been reading what you write daily. It’s been a great source of motivation for the whole team.

Now for update info:
Content
-        Updated controller button graphics.
-         Added basic keyboard support. Details below.


- Click Play and select “Launch Configuration Tool” in the pop-up dialogue box to open the key assignment tool.
- Then, use the pull-down menus to assign keys to each controller button input used in-game.  Button icons are based off Xbox Controller buttons.
Note: In-game button icons currently use Xbox 360 and Steam Controller icons. This will be fixed in our second large content update.
- Select “Restore Defaults” to return to the default key mapping.
- Select “Save & Exit” to save your key assignments and close the tool.


- If multiple buttons are assigned the same key, the last button assigned will be used. Previously assigned buttons will be unassigned and registered as “None” instead.
- Due to supporting multiple keyboards, not all keys can be assigned to buttons.
- The in-game menu cannot be used to assign keyboard controls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585670/9f5fea52b4fe20cdad5c78651bf1df81757b1bfd.png

Bug Fixes
-        Fixed a bug that caused controller input to become unresponsive.

Other News
We are planning on sharing details with you about our first content update soon!
We’ll be putting on a few events to interact with the community and have some fun, so stay tuned.

The Little Noah Development Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585670/02a60cbb17c7c7cbfa36a89fbd50dee2ef4993d0.png

notes.title: The Alchemical Update #02
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Greetings from the Little Noah Development Team.

We're excited to share with you all our major announcement timeline for the next few months!
You can check the upcoming content and features in this handy infographic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585670/a718c441a9c92513cdd5dda2b7af7cfedc85f48a.png

We are planning to release free major updates in early August and September, 2022.
These updates will offer new and more challenging gameplay, such as a hardcore "Hell Mode" and the "Witch's Trials" that'll put any veteran alchemist to the test.

We're also planning to release DLC 1 and DLC 2 in August and September respectively, alongside the free updates. Among various new accessories, lilliputs, and avatars, pay special attention to the Princess Connect! Re:Dive collaboration avatar for DLC 1 and the Umamusume: Pretty Derby collaboration avatar for DLC 2! The Umamusume: Pretty Derpy avatar is particularly adorable...

We hope you all continue having fun in the ruins and look forward to the content on the horizon!

The Little Noah Development Team.

notes.title: The Alchemical Update #01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
Greetings from the Little Noah Development Team.

Right now it's the 7th of July here in Japan, which means it's Tanabata!
It's often said that if one writes down a wish on a slip of paper called a "tanzaku" and ties it to some bamboo grass, the wish will come true!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585670/73f698139ff07f296e97a229a4235e1f440925e2.png

Noah celebrating Tanabata with the Lilliput gang. That wish looks suspicious...


Now for some news:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585670/60dfdfcfb1d79b3c044089150001b9d183528f6b.png
We are planning to have our first content update in August!
Some new dungeon content as well as a challenging gameplay mode are being worked on as we write this message, so stay tuned for details.

Last but not least, along with the free update in August we will be releasing a paid DLC with new Avatars, Lilliputs, and Accessories for you to put to the test.
DLC details can be found on our official website, so please take a look!
 


We hope you all look forward to future updates and continue to have fun with Little Noah: Scion of Paradise!

The Little Noah Development Team
